page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated parallel processing capabilities. It features four vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 30.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration is distinguished by the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, alongside 472 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance tradeoff between general-purpose compute and GPU-accelerated tasks. The host CPU and memory subsystem demonstrate weak to poor performance in standard benchmarks, with stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% categories respectively. Similarly, memory read and write bandwidths are relatively low. However, the dedicated NVIDIA P100 GPU delivers strong results in machine learning tasks, achieving top-tier performance in LLM prompt processing for both small and medium models, alongside strong text generation speeds for medium models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge offers a budget-friendly entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads. By utilizing mature Intel Xeon Broadwell and NVIDIA Pascal architectures, it provides a cost-effective alternative to newer, more expensive GPU instances for tasks that do not require maximum CPU throughput. This server is best suited for deep learning inference, small-to-medium model execution, and GPU-assisted data processing where CPU and memory bandwidth are not the primary bottlenecks.
